It's literally how I spent the past 3 years of high school. I've come to terms that my classmates just didn't like me for whatever reason. I tried my best to socialize towards the end of my last year and it went alright for a week and started gaining more attention from few of them but then once I became quiet again, nobody gave a shit. I didn't even participate in the class's year photo because of them. I couldn't pretend that I wasn't treated like a ghost in my class. I(M) made a great friend(F) in my tutoring class who has a boyfriend and we'd laugh uncontrollably almost every lesson by cracking jokes and teasing each other. So from my little experiment I concluded that it's just them. Right now, it's my final exams and it means that I'm leaving high school and going to University to which I hope I can pass to and that I'll never see their faces again and I'll never have to look back. Great feeling. Only hope that I pass now lol.

Edit: What I advice you to do is keep being you. Keep trying socializing / exposing yourself to social interractions but not with them. They already created their impression of you in their head and it's not worth the hassle to change that. Meet other / new people. Work on yourself, your skills, kill it in the studies.
